policy: The first torch entry is the floor, the latest patch of the PyTorch minor MIN_TORCH (build_support.py); the rest are the latest patches of the three newest stable minors. cuda lists the CUDA versions download.pytorch.org publishes for that torch, except those the CUDA sources don't build with: 12.6 is skipped because its CCCL (2.5) lacks thrust::tabulate_output_iterator, which recur_scan.cuh uses. python is the newest CPython that PyPI has a manylinux x86_64 wheel of that torch for, free-threaded builds excluded; the tests run there. Each wheel is built once, on the oldest CPython requires-python allows: the CPU wheel on the floor torch, and each CUDA wheel on the oldest torch that has its CUDA major, with the oldest CUDA of that major. The stable ABI lets a wheel load on every torch from the floor on, so the wheels are tested on the others. cuda_arch_lists, by CUDA major, mirrors the x86_64 list PyTorch's own wheels use for that CUDA in the release branch of the torch that builds the wheel (.ci/wheel/linux/build_env_setup.py), with +PTX on the highest architecture; a branch without the table keeps the existing list. build_image is changed by hand. Linux x86_64 only; PyPI remains the CPU-only channel.
